properties.decision: OPEN, for Anthony. As built on feat/hypothesis-tests (2026-10-19), a family's α is a sum budget (composition sum): each test spends the α it ran at, and the served recipe gives Bonferroni shares rounded down. Holm (step-down) and Benjamini–Hochberg (false discovery rate) are not sums, so the recipe records the procedure as a Decision and keeps Bonferroni shares as the budget. Options: (a) keep it (as built; no code); (b) a new `composition` value (e.g. `holm`, `fdr_bh`) under which budget_report orders the family's p-values and judges each test's decision against its step-down threshold, reading the p-values from the recorded blocks; (c) leave the rollup alone and add a read-only family report beside it. Also open: whether FWER or FDR is the default the recipe teaches (as built: FWER, Bonferroni).
properties.name: Should the α budget judge Holm and Benjamini–Hochberg, or keep Bonferroni shares only? And is FWER or FDR the default?
properties.rationale: The requirement says add code only where the rollup cannot express it; Holm and BH are exactly what it cannot, so this is the owner's call rather than a guess. Session: https://claude.ai/code/session_019Xbw6PG9mXJiU2Sb421fnq
